rules.attested-match: the form occurs in orig/nt under the paradigm's lemma with a morph code whose description (minus any "name:" tag) equals the cell's parse
rules.attested-other: the form occurs, but not with that lemma + parse (seenAs lists what the data has; otherLemma = only under other lemmas) — check these
rules.unattested: the form does not occur in the NT
rules.matching: forms compared in Unicode NFC with grave read as acute and punctuation/elision marks dropped; if no exact hit, retried ignoring accents (how = "ignoring accents"); "(ν)" = movable nu, both spellings tried
